name: @agents-js/example-renderer-adapter-prototype
description: Slot-2 host-local prototype proving the RendererAdapter lifecycle types from @agents-js/a2ui-host (ADR-0009). Demonstrates mount/apply/resize/capture/stats/dispose ordering against a mock canvas target, and binds capture() to @agents-js/canvas-model so it emits a real JSON Canvas durable artifact (ADR-0009 slot-2 goal b).
